verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed in the Châteauesque style by the Montreal firm Ross and MacFarlane.
verified_facts.excerpt: with Montreal firm Ross and MacFarlane designing it in full Châteauesque style

verified_facts.text: The hotel is named for Sir John A. Macdonald, Canada's first prime minister.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's named for Sir John A. Macdonald, Canada's first prime minister

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on a bluff above the North Saskatchewan River in downtown Edmonton.
verified_facts.excerpt: a 1915 Châteauesque landmark on a bluff above the North Saskatchewan River

verified_facts.text: A glass-sided funicular drops from the hotel's area down to the river valley trails.
verified_facts.excerpt: a glass-sided funicular drops you straight onto the trails

verified_facts.text: The Art Gallery of Alberta and Royal Alberta Museum are a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Art Gallery of Alberta and Royal Alberta Museum are a 10-minute walk

verified_facts.text: The Harvest Room serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with river views and a menu built on Alberta beef, wild game, Ocean Wise seafood and herbs from the hotel's own garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Harvest Room handles three-meals-a-day duty with river views and a menu built on Alberta beef

verified_facts.text: The Confederation Lounge makes cocktails with the hotel's own honey and homemade bitters.
verified_facts.excerpt: cocktails built with the hotel's backyard honey, homemade bitters

verified_facts.text: Weekend afternoon tea is offered, with signature sandwiches, delicate pastries and loose-leaf teas.
verified_facts.excerpt: complete with signature sandwiches, delicate pastries and a curated selection of Fairmont’s finest loose-leaf teas

verified_facts.text: Sunday brunch buffet is held in the Empire Ballroom with live cooking stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hosted within the storied walls of the Empire Ballroom, Sunday brunch features a sustainability focused menu executed right before your eyes at our signature live cooking stations.

verified_facts.text: The health club has two floors with a saltwater pool, whirlpool, outdoor sun deck and squash court.
verified_facts.excerpt: a two-story health club with a saltwater pool, and whirlpool, outdoor sun deck, squash court, massage services

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a resident Canine Ambassador and welcomes pets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Home to Canine Ambassador, Hendricks, Fairmont Hotel Macdonald is delighted to welcome your favorite pets along for the experience.

verified_facts.text: Fairmont Gold rooms have private check-in and concierge on the 7th floor, deluxe continental breakfast and evening canapes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering private check-in and concierge on the 7th floor, deluxe continental breakfast and evening canapes.

verified_facts.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Suite is a bi-level suite with a large foyer, a service pantry and a dining and living area for hosting private dinners.
verified_facts.excerpt: This regal bi-level suite offers a unique layout featuring a large foyer, service pantry, a dining and living area, ideal for hosting private dinners.

verified_facts.text: Hallway noise can carry into rooms, depending on how booked the hotel is; light sleepers should bring ear plugs.
Some city-facing rooms have a single narrow window, so the room can feel dim.
verified_facts.excerpt: some city-facing rooms make do with a single narrow one, so the room can feel dim

verified_facts.text: Parking is available for an additional fee, with indoor parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee
